meta.name: obsidian-markdown
meta.description: Create and edit Obsidian Flavored Markdown with wikilinks, embeds, callouts, properties, and other Obsidian-specific syntax. Use when working with .md files in Obsidian, or when the user mentions wikilinks, callouts, frontmatter, tags, embeds, or Obsidian notes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 编辑 Obsidian 专属 Markdown 语法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你用 Obsidian 写笔记，需要处理 wikilink、callout 等特殊语法。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Obsidian for notes and need to handle wikilinks, callouts, etc.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会按 Obsidian 语法编写和修改 Markdown 笔记,使用内部链接、嵌入、标注框、属性等专属格式,并确保代码块、表格、LaTeX、Mermaid 等写法合规。
howto.when: 当用户处理 Obsidian 中的 .md 文件,或提到 wikilinks、callouts、frontmatter 等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我在笔记里加一个可折叠的 callout,标题是“重点”
say.note: 会生成带 +/− 标记的折叠标注框。

say.text: 用 wikilink 把这几个笔记互相链接起来
say.note: 会写成 [[笔记名]] 格式的内部链接。

say.text: 给这篇笔记添加 frontmatter,包含标题、日期和标签
say.note: 会在开头生成 YAML 属性块。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude creates and edits Markdown notes in Obsidian syntax, using internal links, embeds, callouts, properties, and ensures code blocks, tables, LaTeX, Mermaid are correctly formatted.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user works with .md files in Obsidian, or mentions keywords like wikilinks, callouts, frontmatter.

say_en.text: Add a collapsible callout titled 'Key points' to my note.
say_en.note: Generates a foldable callout with +/- marker.

say_en.text: Link these notes to each other using wikilinks.
Add frontmatter to this note with title, date, and tags.
say_en.note: Creates a YAML block at the top.
